implemented: Workspace form for a reviewer to score an answer against an approved immutable benchmark.
Run labels, correctness, missed required risks, unsupported assertions and an explanatory note.
Aggregate and per-label metrics plus a comparison restricted to the intersection of approved benchmark identities across all labels.
Every new evaluation binds the exact approval record, including its unique record ID, by hash.
Revoked or changed approvals exclude prior evaluations; reapproval cannot resurrect them, even with identical timestamps.
Legacy evaluations without approval binding remain stored but are counted separately and excluded from current means.
Task/account/matter resets clear scoring inputs; late replies cannot repopulate results or trigger a follow-up under a changed task.
No SQLite schema migration, real legal approval or provider configuration performed.

regression_proof.scenario: Approve benchmark, score answer, revoke, then reapprove the same benchmark.

validation.skip_reason: Russian OCR language data not installed.

limits: Synthetic temporary accounts and approval records test mechanisms only; no real lawyer-accepted answer was added.
Run labels and answer provenance are human declarations, not proof of actual model execution.
Averages are per evaluation, not per unique matter; a common benchmark set does not by itself establish statistical superiority.
The approval hash is not a signature or protection from an operator with full database access.
Real model/search checks remain blocked by missing configuration; browser acceptance remains blocked by missing Chromium.
Primary source retries returned HTTP 503 in this execution environment; no new original or approved edition was obtained.
